basic_info.description:
Welcome to 2931 San Bruno Avenue, a splendid San Francisco home where elegance meets functionality. This residence offers four spacious bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, designed to cater to your every need. On the main level, you'll find a beautifully open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, perfect for both day-to-day living and entertaining. The high ceilings and recessed lighting create an airy and inviting atmosphere, while the kitchen boasts abundant cabinet space for all your culinary essentials. 

The primary bedroom, also located on the main level, provides a private retreat featuring ample space and comfort. Step outside to the deck, which guides you to a low-maintenance backyard, an ideal space for relaxation or hosting friends. The deck also leads to a versatile bonus room, offering endless possibilities for use as a home office, gym, or creative studio. 

The downstairs area is equally impressive, featuring a separate living room and a convenient kitchenette. This setup is perfect for extended family, guests, or even as an in-law suite, providing privacy and additional living space. Experience the perfect blend of style and practicality in this thoughtfully designed home, nestled in the vibrant heart of San Francisco.
